description: Trafikinformation vägkarta is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by trafikverket.se. An application where there is information about the traffic situation (events and road works with a high impact on traffic), all road works, events with restrictions on the road, rest areas, traffic safety cameras, traffic cameras, road weather with camera images, road conditions information, road ferries and frost damage. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic information road map" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include map service, karttjänst. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
